papers.title: Conjugated Metal‐Organic Frameworks on Laser‐Induced‐Graphene Scaffold Enable Picomolar Sensitivity in Electrical Biosensors
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Conjugated metal–organic frameworks (c‐MOFs) are a promising class of materials thanks to their high surface area, abundant active sites, and intrinsic electrical conductivity. However, their integration into electronic devices remains challenging, especially in forming uniform 3D thin films. Here, we present a versatile strategy for the layer‐by‐layer (LbL) growth of a conductive MOF film, copper hexaiminotriphenylene (CuHITP), onto a 3D laser‐induced graphene (LIG) scaffold. The LIG template, prepared by femtosecond laser irradiation of polyimide, provides a hierarchical macroporous structure that increases the accessible surface area for MOF nucleation and bioreceptor immobilization. The resulting CuHITP layer conformally replicates the LIG structure while maintaining extended π‐conjugation and high conductivity. When integrated into an extended‐gate field‐effect transistor (EG‐FET), the CuHITP/LIG hybrid enables sensitive cortisol detection. By exploiting both the amine functionalities and unsaturated metal sites of the MOF framework, we achieve stable covalent and coordination‐based immobilization of thiolated aptamers. The sensor exhibits a wide detection range from 1 pM to 10 µM in diluted buffer and retains sub‐picomolar sensitivity in artificial sweat. This work highlights a robust approach for integrating c‐MOFs into electronic biosensors and advances the development of non‐invasive health‐monitoring platforms.

papers.title: Siloxane Molecular Glue for Ultrarobust Interface Engineering in High‐Performance Colloidal Quantum Dot Infrared Image Sensors
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Interfacial defects and poor mechanical robustness critically limit the performance of colloidal quantum dot (CQD) photodiodes for infrared imaging. Here, we introduce a bifunctional organosilane, (3‐mercaptopropyl) methyldimethoxysilane (MDMS), as an interfacial layer to simultaneously address these challenges in inverted PbS CQD photodiodes. MDMS molecules form robust covalent bridging at the CQDs/electron transport layer (ETL) interface through thiol‐based coordination and hydrolysis‐condensation into a cross‐linked siloxane network. This interface engineering not only reinforces mechanical adhesion (achieving 5B rating in ASTM D3359 tests vs. 0B/1B for C 60 controls) but also provides an ideal nucleation surface for ALD‐grown SnO 2 ETL, suppressing island‐like growth and interfacial defects. The optimized devices deliver a specific detectivity of 2.37×10 12 Jones at 1550 nm under 0 V while maintaining 79% EQE under −0.1 V, with dark current reduced by >50% compared to C 60 ‐based controls. Monolithic integration with a silicon ROIC yields a SWIR imager with outstanding photoresponse non‐uniformity (2.8%) and spatial resolution (26 lp/mm at 50% MTF), demonstrating silicon wafer perspectivity and material discrimination. This work provides an efficient strategy for addressing interfacial issues in CQD optoelectronics.

papers.title: Polymorphism in Covalent Organic Frameworks Regulates Excited Dynamics for H 2 O 2 Photosynthesis Coupled With Biomass Valorization
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Polymorphism in covalent organic frameworks (COFs) offers a unique platform to decipher structure–property relationships, yet its impact on excited‐state dynamics remains unexplored. Herein, we construct two chemically identical but topologically distinct 1D and 2D COF polymorphs to correlate framework architecture with photocatalytic performance. Impressively, in H 2 O 2 photosynthesis coupled with furfuryl alcohol valorization, the 1D‐TBPP‐COF showed an exceptional H 2 O 2 generation rate (18.75 mmol g −1 h −1 ) and selective oxidation of furfuryl alcohol to high‐value 6‐hydroxy‐2H‐pyran‐3(6H)‐one (PN) with PN formation rate of 28.14 mmol·g −1 ·h −1 , substantially outperforming the 2D‐TBPP‐COF counterpart. Mechanistic investigations revealed that the intercalated dual‐chain edges in 1D‐TBPP‐COF impose steric constraints on aromatic ring rotation, effectively suppressing vibrational relaxation losses and prolonging the charge‐transfer state lifetime. In contrast, the conformationally flexible 2D‐TBPP‐COF permits greater rotational freedom, leading to non‐radiative energy dissipation. This work establishes polymorphism engineering as a powerful strategy to manipulate excited‐state dynamics in COFs for photocatalysis.

papers.title: Bio‐Inspired Mesoporous Solar Evaporator Enabled by Upcycled PET
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Solar‐driven interfacial steam generation (ISSG) has emerged as a promising strategy for decentralized freshwater production. However, developing scalable solar evaporators that combine high evaporation performance, environmental compatibility, and stable operation under varying solar angles remains challenging. Here, we report a compound‐eye‐inspired three‐dimensional solar evaporator based on graphite‐containing PET nanofoam (GPF). The GPF was produced by upcycling polyethylene terephthalate (PET) waste. The nonsolvent‐induced phase separation process produces a mesoporous and moldable structure with tunable water transport properties, enabling the construction of hemispherical multi‐surface evaporators. This architecture provides angle‐insensitive solar exposure and an enlarged water‐wetted evaporative interface within a fixed projected footprint. As a result, the optimized evaporator achieved a projected‐area‐normalized evaporation rate of 3.44 kg m − 2 h − 1 under 1‐sun illumination. In outdoor operation, the integrated evaporation‐condensation module produced a freshwater yield of up to 24.4 kg m − 2 over 14 h under natural sunlight. The enhanced performance arises from the combined effects of expanded evaporation‐active area, capillary‐sustained water transport, side‐surface evaporation, and internal heat redistribution. This result indicates that the 3D‐CE improves evaporation through coupled transport and thermal effects, rather than through surface‐area enlargement alone. This work presents a potential route for converting waste PET into functional solar evaporators for decentralized freshwater production.

papers.research_details_zh: 研究旨在解决太阳能界面蒸汽生成（ISSG）中高效、可扩展且环境友好的蒸发器开发难题。通过非溶剂诱导相分离法，将回收的PET废料制备成具有介孔和可塑性的石墨含量PET纳米泡沫（GPF）。该材料用于构建具有多表面蒸发功能的半球形蒸发器，提供角度不敏感的太阳能暴露和扩展的水润湿蒸发界面。优化后的蒸发器在1倍太阳光照下实现了3.44 kg m⁻² h⁻¹的蒸发速率，并在自然阳光下的户外操作中，集成的蒸发-冷凝模块在14小时内产生了24.4 kg m⁻²的淡水产量。研究表明，性能提升源于扩展的蒸发活性区域、毛细管驱动的水传输、侧表面蒸发以及内部热量再分配的协同作用。

papers.title: Engineering Frustrated Packing of Porous Organic Cages for Precision Acetylene–Ethylene Separation
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Porous organic cages (POCs) are emerging porous molecular materials with their tunable porosity and solution processability. Beyond the intrinsic pores within individual cage molecules, extrinsic pores generated by intermolecular packing play a critical role in defining the porosity and separation performance of POCs. These packing‐derived pores can connect discrete cage cavities, impose size‐selective constraints, and create tailored adsorption microenvironments. However, their systematic design and utilization remain underdeveloped, as current synthetic and post‐synthetic modification strategies largely focus on intrinsic‐pore engineering. In this study, we report an extrinsic pores engineering strategy based on the structural modification of tetrazine‐based POCs. By tuning cage shape and peripheral steric hindrance, we precisely modulate frustrated packing to achieve highly selective acetylene uptake. The optimized cage, m ‐4N‐cage , exhibits excellent acetylene/ethylene separation performance in adsorption and breakthrough experiments, comparable to that of the best‐performing porous molecular organic materials. In situ single‐crystal diffraction analysis reveals that acetylene molecules are selectively adsorbed within the tailored extrinsic pores. This work highlights extrinsic pores as a tunable design element for targeted separations and establishes as a model platform for controlling frustrated packing in molecular crystal engineering.

papers.research_details_zh: 该研究针对多孔有机笼（POC）的外源孔工程展开，提出通过调控笼分子的形状和外围空间位阻来优化分子堆积，从而实现对外源孔的精确调控。研究以含四嗪基团的POC为模型，通过结构修饰优化了其堆积模式，使其在吸附和穿透实验中表现出优异的乙炔/乙烯分离性能。通过原位单晶衍射分析，研究揭示了乙炔分子优先吸附于经调控的外源孔内的机制。该工作展示了外源孔作为设计元素在分子晶体工程中的潜力，为开发高效分离材料提供了新思路。

papers.title_zh: 共价有机框架中的多晶型调控激发态动力学以实现与生物质增值耦合的H2O2光合成
papers.summary_zh: 研究通过构建1D和2D COF多晶型材料，揭示框架结构对光催化性能的影响。1D COF表现出优异的H2O2生成速率和选择性氧化性能，显著优于2D COF。
papers.research_details_zh: 本研究探讨了共价有机框架（COFs）多晶型对激发态动力学的影响。通过设计化学组成相同但拓扑结构不同的1D和2D COF多晶型材料，研究其在H2O2光合成及糠醇氧化为高附加值产物6-羟基-2H-吡喃-3(6H)-酮（PN）中的性能差异。结果表明，1D-TBPP-COF由于其双链边缘的空间位阻效应，抑制了芳环旋转和振动弛豫损失，从而延长了电荷转移态寿命，表现出更高的光催化效率。相比之下，2D-TBPP-COF因其更大的构象自由度导致非辐射能量耗散增加。研究表明，多晶型工程是调控COFs激发态动力学以优化光催化性能的有效策略。
papers.methods_zh: 研究通过设计1D和2D COF多晶型材料，结合光催化性能测试、动力学分析和机理研究，探讨框架结构与性能的关系。具体方法包括H2O2生成速率和PN生成速率的测定，以及对激发态动力学的深入分析。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究通过多晶型工程调控COFs的激发态动力学，为优化光催化性能提供了新思路，特别是在H2O2光合成和生物质增值领域具有重要意义。研究结果对设计高效光催化材料具有指导价值，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是基于摘要的解读，实验条件、具体表征方法和完整机理分析需通过全文核查以获取更详细信息。
key_findings_zh: 1D-TBPP-COF的H2O2生成速率为18.75 mmol g−1 h−1，显著高于2D-TBPP-COF。
1D-TBPP-COF的PN生成速率为28.14 mmol g−1 h−1，表现出优异的选择性氧化性能。
1D-TBPP-COF通过空间位阻效应抑制芳环旋转，延长了电荷转移态寿命。
2D-TBPP-COF因构象自由度增加导致非辐射能量耗散增强。

papers.title: Supramolecular Polymer‐Surfactant Co‐Assemblies for Multivalent HSV‐1 Inhibition
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Supramolecular assemblies are of fundamental importance for cellular life and bio‐interactive materials. The structure and function of these assemblies are decisively influenced by the design of their molecular components. In this work, we present a modular synthetic strategy for six novel bio‐functional surfactants with a sulfonate headgroup (termed SupraVir surfactants). These amphiphilic molecules were designed for strong interactions with viral envelope proteins, virus inhibition, and to co‐assemble water‐soluble benzene‐1,3,5‐tricarboxamide derivatives (BTAs) to generate surfactant‐grafted supramolecular polymers. Systematic spectroscopic and microscopic studies showed that the morphology of the co‐assemblies strongly depends on the surfactant‐BTA ratio. At surfactant ratios higher than 1, the native BTA nanofibers were disrupted, resulting in micellar architectures. In the test with herpes simplex virus (HSV‐1), fibrous supramolecular polymers show significantly lower half‐maximal inhibitory concentrations (IC 50 ) compared to the corresponding micellar aggregates of the pure surfactants. Interestingly, the co‐assemblies exhibited lower cytotoxicity than the functional surfactants alone, probably due to their structured incorporation into the polymeric scaffold. The dynamics of the co‐assemblies, probed by hydrogen‐deuterium exchange mass spectrometry (HDX‐MS), showed correlations to the effectiveness. These results demonstrate a new co‐assembly strategy of functional positioning antiviral surfactants in supramolecular scaffolds for the development of multivalent antiviral materials.

papers.title_zh: 超分子聚合物-表面活性剂共组装用于多价HSV-1抑制
papers.summary_zh: 研究开发了一种模块化合成策略，设计六种具有磺酸盐头基的新型生物功能表面活性剂，通过与BTA衍生物共组装形成超分子聚合物，用于多价抗病毒材料的开发。
papers.research_details_zh: 本研究提出了一种模块化合成策略，设计并合成了六种新型生物功能表面活性剂（SupraVir表面活性剂），这些分子具有磺酸盐头基，旨在与病毒包膜蛋白强相互作用。通过与水溶性BTA衍生物共组装，形成表面活性剂修饰的超分子聚合物。系统的光谱和显微研究表明，共组装体的形貌取决于表面活性剂与BTA的比例。当表面活性剂比例高于1时，BTA纳米纤维被破坏，形成胶束结构。在HSV-1测试中，纤维状超分子聚合物的IC50显著低于纯表面活性剂的胶束聚集体。此外，共组装体的细胞毒性低于单一表面活性剂，可能是由于其在聚合物骨架中的结构化嵌入。通过HDX-MS探测共组装体的动态性，发现其与抗病毒效果相关。
papers.methods_zh: 研究采用模块化合成策略制备磺酸盐头基表面活性剂，并与BTA衍生物共组装。通过光谱学和显微技术研究共组装体的形貌和结构，利用HDX-MS分析其动态性，并通过HSV-1病毒抑制实验评估其抗病毒性能。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究展示了通过超分子共组装策略开发多价抗病毒材料的新方法，强调了结构-功能关系和动态性的关键作用。对于研究框架材料的自组装和功能化具有重要启发意义，值得全文精读。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是基于摘要的解读，实验条件、具体数值和机制细节需通过全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 纤维状超分子聚合物的IC50显著低于纯表面活性剂的胶束聚集体。
共组装体的细胞毒性低于单一表面活性剂。
共组装体的动态性与抗病毒效果相关。

papers.title: Constructing of Bimetal Covalent Organic Framework Based on Porphyrin as Photocatalyst and Electrocatalyst
papers.abstract: A bimetallic COF (CoTAPP‐PDB‐COF‐Ni) has been designed and synthesized to be used as bifunctional catalyst in photocatalysis and electrocatalysis. The hyperconjugated structure and the bimetallic active site enable CoTAPP‐PDB‐COF‐Ni to absorb light energy and electrical energy to transfer them into chemical energy for corresponding catalysis. As a photocatalyst, CoTAPP‐PDB‐COF‐Ni can adsorb visible light to active oxygen into reactive oxygen species to degrade small organic aromatic hetercyclic molecules such as RhB, MB, and TC‐HCl. And as the heterogeneous photocatalyst, CoTAPP‐PDB‐COF‐Ni should be recycled in aqueous solution at least for four cycles with stable structure. As electrocatalyst, CoTAPP‐PDB‐COF‐Ni has to dope with acetylene black to improve conductivity to achieve highly efficient electrocatalysis. From the results, CoTAPP‐PDB‐COF‐Ni exhibits efficient HER/OER with excellent electrocatalytic activity. In short, we provide a new way for the development of bifunctional catalyst based on COF through the molecular design both in light energy and in electrical energy transfer.

papers.title_zh: 基于卟啉的双金属共价有机框架的构建及其光催化和电催化性能
papers.summary_zh: 研究设计并合成了一种双金属COF（CoTAPP-PDB-COF-Ni），用于光催化和电催化，展示了其在有机污染物降解和HER/OER中的高效催化性能。
papers.research_details_zh: 本研究设计了一种基于卟啉的双金属共价有机框架（CoTAPP-PDB-COF-Ni），其超共轭结构和双金属活性位点使其能够吸收光能和电能并转化为化学能。作为光催化剂，该COF能够吸收可见光并将氧气活化为活性氧物种，用于降解有机芳香杂环分子（如RhB、MB和TC-HCl）。此外，该COF在水溶液中可稳定循环使用至少四次。作为电催化剂，需掺杂乙炔黑以提高导电性，从而实现高效的析氢反应（HER）和析氧反应（OER）。研究为通过分子设计开发同时适用于光催化和电催化的双功能COF提供了新思路。
papers.methods_zh: 通过分子设计合成双金属COF（CoTAPP-PDB-COF-Ni），并结合光催化和电催化实验评估其性能。光催化实验用于降解有机污染物，电催化实验则测试HER和OER活性，此外还进行了循环稳定性测试。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究展示了通过分子设计实现光催化和电催化双功能COF的潜力，特别是在能源转化和环境修复领域具有重要意义。研究方法和结果值得深入探讨。
papers.evidence_note_zh: 这是基于摘要的解读，具体的催化条件、性能数据和结构表征细节需通过全文核查。
key_findings_zh: CoTAPP-PDB-COF-Ni可高效降解RhB、MB和TC-HCl等有机污染物。
掺杂乙炔黑后，COF在HER/OER中表现出优异的电催化活性。
COF在水溶液中可稳定循环使用至少四次。

papers.title_zh: 通过阴极电沉积制备三重协同抗污导电MOFs用于电化学传感器
papers.introduction_zh: 本研究提出了一种新型导电金属有机框架（MOF），通过阴极电沉积方法制备，具有三重协同抗污性能。研究的核心问题是解决电化学传感器在复杂环境中因污染物吸附导致的灵敏度下降问题。通过设计导电MOF的结构，研究者实现了抗污性能与导电性能的结合，显著提高了传感器的稳定性和检测能力。主要结论表明，这种导电MOF在实际应用中具有优异的抗污能力和电化学性能，为开发高性能传感器提供了新思路。
papers.methods_zh: 研究采用阴极电沉积技术，将导电MOF直接组装在电极表面。通过调控电沉积条件，优化了MOF的结构和性能。实验中使用了电化学测试（如循环伏安法和电化学阻抗谱）评估材料的导电性和抗污性能。由于摘要未提供具体实验细节，无法进一步确认具体的实验参数和材料表征方法。
papers.relevance_zh: 该研究与介孔导电MOF和电化学合成的研究主线高度相关。其创新点在于通过电化学方法制备导电MOF并赋予抗污性能，为电化学传感器的实际应用提供了新方向。然而，摘要未提及材料的孔隙结构和导电机制的详细分析，这可能限制了对其在更广泛领域应用的理解。
